target: Dr Sun's purchased current Lite3 Pro

coordinate_frame.origin: midpoint of the front left/right visible hole axes
coordinate_frame.y_axis: +Y points toward the robot left side
coordinate_frame.z_axis: +Z points upward from the local seating plane

receiver_points.label: front_left_axis
requested_measurements: thread designation verified with a thread gauge or known loose screw used only by hand
usable threaded depth measured without forcing a probe
top recess/counterbore diameter
top recess/counterbore depth
receiver material
whether a metal threaded insert is present
where the receiver transfers load below the cover

receiver_points.label: front_right_axis
requested_measurements: thread designation verified independently from point A
usable threaded depth measured without forcing a probe
top recess/counterbore diameter
top recess/counterbore depth
receiver material
whether a metal threaded insert is present
where the receiver transfers load below the cover

receiver_points.label: centre_rear_candidate_axis
receiver_points.role_candidate: unknown; may be a cover screw rather than a structural receiver
requested_measurements: confirm whether the visible feature is a removable screw, threaded receiver, or unthreaded hole
thread designation if it is a receiver
usable threaded depth if it is a receiver
top recess/counterbore diameter and depth
receiver material and any metal insert
where the feature transfers load below the cover

requested_evidence: enclosure feet and the actual seating gap
ventilation openings and required free-air region
all connector bodies plus inserted plug envelopes
cable bend radius and strain-relief sweep
tool-access cylinders above every selected fastener

measurement_safety: Power the robot off before measuring around connectors or covers.
Do not use a powered driver and do not force a screw or gauge into an unknown thread.
Do not remove a structural or sealed cover screw merely to identify its thread.
Record a perpendicular close-up with a ruler or caliper for each accepted dimension.

required_before_release: D service and cable keep-out record
human review of the selected receiver set

claim_boundary: This request records what must be measured. It does not identify a screw, approve a receiver, or authorize fabrication.
